slides.title: Validate long component labels and detailed cross-cutting concerns against measured text fit
slides.role: A deliberate long-copy stress case for bounded architecture cells
slides.takeaway: Longer descriptions should be shortened or split after reviewing actual measurement evidence.

left_rail.label: Access management
left_rail.detail: Confirm which business and support roles can read, change, approve, and audit each workflow.

left_rail.label: Operational visibility
left_rail.detail: Define service ownership, actionable alerts, trace context, and support handoffs before expanding traffic.

components.label: Existing desktop experience
components.detail: Retain while journey dependencies and user needs are assessed.

components.label: Candidate browser experience
components.detail: Consider only after workflow evidence and transition constraints are understood.

components.label: Journey-specific service contract
components.detail: Owns a narrow set of business operations and avoids leaking persistence details to the client.

components.label: Legacy integration adapter
components.detail: Coordinates coexistence with existing procedures until replacement behavior is verified.

components.label: Repository and transaction boundary
components.detail: Encapsulates persistence operations, with consistency and recovery behavior to be confirmed.

components.label: Current operational database
components.detail: Migration target and sequence remain decisions for discovery.
